definitions.explanation: The period of Japan's first warrior government, the shogunate that Minamoto no Yoritomo set up at Kamakura, from about 1185 until its fall in 1333. Power passed from court nobles to the samurai, and new schools of Buddhism spread among ordinary people.

⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{仏像|ぶつぞう}→仏像：09638_butsuzou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{鎌倉時代|かまくらじだい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{作|つく}られた→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: This Buddhist statue was made in the Kamakura period.

notes:
Named after ⟦{鎌倉|かまくら}→鎌倉：30711_kamakura⟧, the seaside town south of present-day Tokyo where the shogunate had its seat.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {鎌倉幕府|かまくらばくふ}: the Kamakura shogunate
- {鎌倉時代|かまくらじだい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{武士|ぶし}→武士：03989_bushi⟧: Kamakura-period samurai
- {鎌倉仏教|かまくらぶっきょう}: the new Buddhist schools of the period

CULTURAL NOTE:
Students once memorized the founding year as ⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦{国|くに}→国：02204_kuni⟧つくろう (1192); textbooks now favor 1185, remembered as ⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦{箱|はこ}→箱：02162_hako⟧つくろう. Its key figures include {源頼朝|みなもとのよりとも}, the Hōjō regents, and the monks {親鸞|しんらん}, {道元|どうげん}, and {日蓮|にちれん}.
